name: Babylon Summer 2022
information:
# Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition.
# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:
##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, September 4th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
##### **OR** 
##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, September 14th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. 
#### 
##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. 
##### 

Please enter through the entrance in the front of the venue next to the American Legion Way pillar. The other entrances will have signs on them directing you to the right place. Please do not enter through the other entrances.
